name: kube-noob
description: Kubernetes, OpenShift, ROSA HCP, Helm and RHACS expertise as tools for Claude: audit YAML, diagnose read-only first, cite docs, learn with graded exercises. No AI inside: Claude does the thinking. kube-noob runs locally and makes no network calls of its own; uv installs its hash-pinned dependencies once.

must_gather_dir.title: must-gather folder (optional)
must_gather_dir.description: A folder of extracted OpenShift must-gather dumps that analyze_must_gather may read. Claude Code asks you for it rather than kube-noob reading a variable from your machine. Leave it unset and the tool reads any path you name in the conversation. kube-noob only reads: it never writes there, never copies it anywhere and makes no network calls of its own.
